info.textSample: Skip to content DAVID'S MASTER POT HOME MENU STORES PROMOTIONS WHAT'S NEW FRANCHISE CLUB DAVID DAVID'S MASTER POT BUILD YOUR OWN HOT POT SINCE 2018 SEE THE MENU FIND A STORE AUTHENTIC SICHUAN FLAVOURS ASSISTED SELF-SERVE HOTPOT BUFFET LOVED ACROSS AUSTRALIA EAT AS YOU WISH BRAND STORY EVERY BOWL TELLS A STORY At David's Master Pot, every bowl tells a story. One of spice, comfort, and community. Now, we're sharing that success, one franchise at a time. Since 2018, we've grown into one of Australia's best-loved hotpot buffets, bringing authentic Sichuan flavours to the land down under. With an assisted self-serve model customers love, guests can eat as they wish. From the first sizzling spoonful to the last sip, our tables are always open, our broth is always bubbling, and the flavours are always unforgettable.
